title: Services logs
description: BIND (transfers, validation and resolution errors), Kea DHCP (leases, HA state), keepalived VIP moves, and the monitoring stack's containers (Grafana, Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Alloy, haproxy, Telegraf, Postgres).

list.name: search
list.label: Search (regex)
list.description: Case-insensitive RE2 regex on the line; empty matches everything.

panels.title: Zone transfers
panels.description: BIND lines matching `Transfer completed` (dns01 + dns02). BIND logs everything at the same level (stderr), so the line decides.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({host=~"dns0[0-9]", app="bind9"} |~ `Transfer completed` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Notifies
panels.description: BIND lines matching `notify from|sending notifies` (dns01 + dns02). BIND logs everything at the same level (stderr), so the line decides.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({host=~"dns0[0-9]", app="bind9"} |~ `notify from|sending notifies` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: DNSSEC validation
panels.description: BIND lines matching `no valid signature|broken trust chain|insecurity proof failed|verify failed|no valid RRSIG` (dns01 + dns02). BIND logs everything at the same level (stderr), so the line decides.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({host=~"dns0[0-9]", app="bind9"} |~ `no valid signature|broken trust chain|insecurity proof failed|verify failed|no valid RRSIG` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Resolution errors
panels.description: BIND lines matching `(?i:servfail|timed out|unreachable|lame server|formerr|connection refused|unexpected RCODE|deadlock found)` (dns01 + dns02). BIND logs everything at the same level (stderr), so the line decides.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({host=~"dns0[0-9]", app="bind9"} |~ `(?i:servfail|timed out|unreachable|lame server|formerr|connection refused|unexpected RCODE|deadlock found)` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Lines
panels.description: All BIND lines. Query logging is off on purpose, so queries are not counted anywhere here.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({host=~"dns0[0-9]", app="bind9"} [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: BIND messages by kind
panels.description: Most validation failures are upstream domains with broken DNSSEC, not our zones. No query series: query logging is off on purpose.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({host=~"dns0[0-9]", app="bind9"} |~ `Transfer completed` [$__auto]))
sum(count_over_time({host=~"dns0[0-9]", app="bind9"} |~ `notify from|sending notifies` [$__auto]))
sum(count_over_time({host=~"dns0[0-9]", app="bind9"} |~ `no valid signature|broken trust chain|insecurity proof failed|verify failed|no valid RRSIG` [$__auto]))
sum(count_over_time({host=~"dns0[0-9]", app="bind9"} |~ `(?i:servfail|timed out|unreachable|lame server|formerr|connection refused|unexpected RCODE|deadlock found)` [$__auto]))

sum(count_over_time({host=~"dns0[0-9]", app="bind9"} !~ `Transfer completed|notify from|sending notifies|no valid signature|broken trust chain|insecurity proof failed|verify failed|no valid RRSIG|(?i:servfail|timed out|unreachable|lame server|formerr|connection refused|unexpected RCODE|deadlock found)` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Zone transfers
panels.description: Completed inbound zone transfers (secondaries).

targets.expr: {host=~"dns0[0-9]", app="bind9"} |= "Transfer completed" | regexp `transfer of '(?P<zone>[^']+)' from (?P<primary>\S+): Transfer completed: (?P<msgs>\d+) messages, (?P<records>\d+) records.*serial (?P<serial>\d+)`

panels.title: BIND (without DNSSEC validation noise)
panels.description: dns01 and dns02, minus 'no valid signature' validation lines.

targets.expr: {host=~"dns0[0-9]", app="bind9"} |~ `(?i)$search` !~ `no valid signature`

panels.title: dhcp01/02: leases allocated
panels.description: Kea lines matching `DHCP4_LEASE_ALLOC` (dhcp01 + dhcp02).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"dhcp0[12]", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} |~ `DHCP4_LEASE_ALLOC` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: dhcp01/02: NAKs
panels.description: Kea lines matching `DHCP4_PACKET_NAK|DHCPNAK` (dhcp01 + dhcp02).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"dhcp0[12]", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} |~ `DHCP4_PACKET_NAK|DHCPNAK` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: dhcp01/02: allocation failures
panels.description: Kea lines matching `ALLOC_FAIL|DHCP4_.*_FAIL|no address available` (dhcp01 + dhcp02).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"dhcp0[12]", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} |~ `ALLOC_FAIL|DHCP4_.*_FAIL|no address available` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: dhcp01/02: HA state changes
panels.description: Kea lines matching `HA_STATE_TRANSITION` (dhcp01 + dhcp02).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"dhcp0[12]", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} |~ `HA_STATE_TRANSITION` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: dhcp01/02: HA comms problems
panels.description: Kea lines matching `HA_COMMUNICATION_INTERRUPTED|HA_HEARTBEAT_FAILED|HA_.*_FAILED|partner .* unavailable` (dhcp01 + dhcp02).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"dhcp0[12]", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} |~ `HA_COMMUNICATION_INTERRUPTED|HA_HEARTBEAT_FAILED|HA_.*_FAILED|partner .* unavailable` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: dhcp01/02: lines
panels.description: All Kea lines (dhcp01 + dhcp02), HA heartbeats left out.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"dhcp0[12]", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} != `'ha-heartbeat'` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: fw-wan: leases allocated
panels.description: Kea lines matching `DHCP4_LEASE_ALLOC` (fw-wan's guest DHCP).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} |~ `DHCP4_LEASE_ALLOC` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: fw-wan: NAKs
panels.description: Kea lines matching `DHCP4_PACKET_NAK|DHCPNAK` (fw-wan's guest DHCP).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} |~ `DHCP4_PACKET_NAK|DHCPNAK` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: fw-wan: allocation failures
panels.description: Kea lines matching `ALLOC_FAIL|DHCP4_.*_FAIL|no address available` (fw-wan's guest DHCP).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} |~ `ALLOC_FAIL|DHCP4_.*_FAIL|no address available` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: fw-wan: lines
panels.description: All Kea lines (fw-wan's guest DHCP), HA heartbeats left out.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} != `'ha-heartbeat'` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Kea messages by code (top 10): cluster HA pair (dhcp01/02)
panels.description: Kea's message IDs on dhcp01 + dhcp02 (DHCP4_LEASE_ALLOC, HA_STATE_TRANSITION, ...), heartbeats left out.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (code) (count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"dhcp0[12]", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} != `'ha-heartbeat'` | regexp `^\s*(?P<sev>[A-Z]+)\s+(?P<code>[A-Z0-9_]+)` [$__auto])))

panels.title: Kea messages by code (top 10): fw-wan (guest)
panels.description: Kea's message IDs on fw-wan (DHCP4_LEASE_ALLOC, HA_STATE_TRANSITION, ...), heartbeats left out.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (code) (count_over_time({source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} != `'ha-heartbeat'` | regexp `^\s*(?P<sev>[A-Z]+)\s+(?P<code>[A-Z0-9_]+)` [$__auto])))

{source="syslog", host=~"dhcp0[12]", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} |= "DHCP4_LEASE_ALLOC" | regexp `\[hwtype=\d+ (?P<mac>[0-9a-f:]+)\].*lease (?P<address>\S+) has been allocated for (?P<seconds>\d+) seconds`

{source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} |= "DHCP4_LEASE_ALLOC" | regexp `\[hwtype=\d+ (?P<mac>[0-9a-f:]+)\].*lease (?P<address>\S+) has been allocated for (?P<seconds>\d+) seconds`

{source="syslog", host=~"dhcp0[12]", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} |= "HA_STATE_TRANSITION" | regexp `HA_STATE_TRANSITION (?P<server>\S+): server transitions from (?P<from>\S+) to (?P<to>\S+) state, partner state is (?P<partner>\S+)`

panels.title: DHCP: cluster HA pair (dhcp01/02)
panels.description: Kea on dhcp01 and dhcp02, minus the HA heartbeat commands.

targets.expr: {source="syslog", host=~"dhcp0[12]", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} |~ `(?i)$search` != `'ha-heartbeat'` !~ `HA_HEARTBEAT|COMMAND_RECEIVED`

panels.title: DHCP: fw-wan (guest)
panels.description: Kea on fw-wan (the guest VRF's DHCP on eth3.4, kea-vrf-helper; no HA).

targets.expr: {source="syslog", host="fw-wan", app=~"kea-dhcp4|kea-vrf-helper"} |~ `(?i)$search`

panels.title: Became MASTER (range)
panels.description: How often each VM took each VRRP instance's VIPs: dns (DNS VIP), grafana (10.2.11.100), logging (Loki/syslog VIP .101), monitoring (.102), mimir (.103), postgres (.104).

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(20, sum by (instance, host) (count_over_time({app="Keepalived_vrrp"} |~ `Entering (MASTER|BACKUP|FAULT) STATE` | regexp `\((?P<instance>[^)]+)\) Entering (?P<state>[A-Z]+) STATE` | state=`MASTER` [$__range]))))

panels.title: VRRP transitions
panels.description: Every state change per instance, VM and new state.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, host, state) (count_over_time({app="Keepalived_vrrp"} |~ `Entering (MASTER|BACKUP|FAULT) STATE` | regexp `\((?P<instance>[^)]+)\) Entering (?P<state>[A-Z]+) STATE` [$__auto]))

panels.title: VRRP state changes
panels.description: keepalived's VRRP state changes on dns01/02, graf01/02, loki01-03, mon01/02, mim01-03 and pg01-03.

targets.expr: {app="Keepalived_vrrp"} |~ `Entering (MASTER|BACKUP|FAULT) STATE` | regexp `\((?P<instance>[^)]+)\) Entering (?P<state>[A-Z]+) STATE`

panels.title: Errors and warnings by container
panels.description: The line's own level (Podman logs stderr as 'err' whatever the line says).

targets.expr: sum by (host, container, level) (count_over_time({source="journal", container=~"$container"} |~ `(?i)$search` | regexp `(?:\blevel="?|\blvl=|^\[|\] |^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\S+Z\s+)(?P<lvl_>[A-Za-z]+)` | label_format level=`{{ $l := lower (or (and .container .lvl_) .level) }}{{ if eq $l "error" "err" "eror" "e" "crit" "critical" "alert" "emerg" "emergency" "fatal" "panic" }}error{{ else if eq $l "warning" "warn" "w" }}warning{{ else if eq $l "notice" }}notice{{ else if eq $l "debug" "trace" "d" }}debug{{ else }}info{{ end }}` | drop lvl_ | level=~`error|warning` [$__auto]))

sort_desc(topk(15, sum by (host, container) (count_over_time({source="journal", container=~"$container"} |~ `(?i)$search` | regexp `(?:\blevel="?|\blvl=|^\[|\] |^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\S+Z\s+)(?P<lvl_>[A-Za-z]+)` | label_format level=`{{ $l := lower (or (and .container .lvl_) .level) }}{{ if eq $l "error" "err" "eror" "e" "crit" "critical" "alert" "emerg" "emergency" "fatal" "panic" }}error{{ else if eq $l "warning" "warn" "w" }}warning{{ else if eq $l "notice" }}notice{{ else if eq $l "debug" "trace" "d" }}debug{{ else }}info{{ end }}` | drop lvl_ | level=`error` [$__range]))))

panels.title: Errors and warnings
panels.description: Warnings and errors of the selected containers.

targets.expr: {source="journal", container=~"$container"} |~ `(?i)$search` | regexp `(?:\blevel="?|\blvl=|^\[|\] |^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\S+Z\s+)(?P<lvl_>[A-Za-z]+)` | label_format level=`{{ $l := lower (or (and .container .lvl_) .level) }}{{ if eq $l "error" "err" "eror" "e" "crit" "critical" "alert" "emerg" "emergency" "fatal" "panic" }}error{{ else if eq $l "warning" "warn" "w" }}warning{{ else if eq $l "notice" }}notice{{ else if eq $l "debug" "trace" "d" }}debug{{ else }}info{{ end }}` | drop lvl_ | level=~"error|warning"

panels.title: haproxy (S3 to the RGWs)
panels.description: Backend state changes ('Server rgw/rgw1 is DOWN') on loki01-03, mim01-03 and pg01-03.

targets.expr: {source="journal", container="haproxy"} |~ `(?i)$search`

panels.title: Loki and Alloy (warnings, errors)
panels.description: Loki and Alloy on all VMs, warning or worse.

targets.expr: {source="journal", container=~"loki|alloy"} |~ `(?i)$search` | regexp `(?:\blevel="?|\blvl=|^\[|\] |^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\S+Z\s+)(?P<lvl_>[A-Za-z]+)` | label_format level=`{{ $l := lower (or (and .container .lvl_) .level) }}{{ if eq $l "error" "err" "eror" "e" "crit" "critical" "alert" "emerg" "emergency" "fatal" "panic" }}error{{ else if eq $l "warning" "warn" "w" }}warning{{ else if eq $l "notice" }}notice{{ else if eq $l "debug" "trace" "d" }}debug{{ else }}info{{ end }}` | drop lvl_ | level=~"error|warning"

panels.title: Prometheus and Alertmanager
panels.description: Config reloads, compactions, rule and notification errors.

targets.expr: {source="journal", container=~"prometheus|alertmanager"} |~ `(?i)$search`

panels.title: Grafana (warnings, errors)
panels.description: graf01 and graf02.

targets.expr: {source="journal", container="grafana"} |~ `(?i)$search` | regexp `(?:\blevel="?|\blvl=|^\[|\] |^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\S+Z\s+)(?P<lvl_>[A-Za-z]+)` | label_format level=`{{ $l := lower (or (and .container .lvl_) .level) }}{{ if eq $l "error" "err" "eror" "e" "crit" "critical" "alert" "emerg" "emergency" "fatal" "panic" }}error{{ else if eq $l "warning" "warn" "w" }}warning{{ else if eq $l "notice" }}notice{{ else if eq $l "debug" "trace" "d" }}debug{{ else }}info{{ end }}` | drop lvl_ | level=~"error|warning"
